dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The primary structures exhibit irregular, amoeboid perimeters with high-frequency crenulation. There is a sharp, high-contrast gradient transition from the dark-grey exterior surface to the off-white interior of the 'O' and 'C' shaped formations.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Numerous small, low-intensity (dark) clusters are densely packed within the light-colored interiors of the macro-annuli. These clusters are solid, lack internal gradients, and are distributed with high spatial frequency in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary linear alignment of smaller high-intensity clusters is visible along the anterior-lateral axis towards the head.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, perfectly straight, high-intensity linear feature is located on the posterior-lateral flank, oriented diagonally. Two shorter, similar linear marks are visible near the caudal extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: The anterior flipper displays five distinct, high-relief vertical ridges with high-contrast tips, indicating the skeletal structure of the digits.
